svg.title: Pipeline rewrite and per-batch handoff
svg.desc: Only eligible sharded-module calls are rewritten; state stays attached to its batch. Solid bars: logical execution/access scopes; hollow dashed bars: unconsumed requests. Blue H2D, red D2H/host sync, purple AllToAll, amber request wait, green stream dependency. Trace eligible inputs; replace forward with a runtime wrapper start_sparse_data_dist(batch): create_context + input_dist Create module context and prepare bucketized input; split communication launches after metadata fusion. batch: dist_splits -> length_per_key -> _safe_tolist Uncached, nonempty CUDA lengths: reduce on GPU, copy to CPU, synchronize the current stream. batch: stage splits / stride as CUDA tensors KJTAllToAllForward returns metadata; compatible split collectives launch after fusion. Store module contexts and split requests Fuse compatible split metadata by process group batch: validate each staged split tensor Pinned-version check: _safe_tolist(t) for each CUDA split tensor, before fused AllToAll; repeated D2H / stream sync. Launch fused split-size AllToAll Compatible metadata is fused per process group. wait_sparse_data_dist: consume the fused split request Host reads and payload launches inside this call are expanded below. batch: read received split sizes on the host _safe_tolist_2d(output_tensor): D2H + current-stream sync; receive sizes are needed before payload allocation. batch: read sent splits for overflow validation The pinned _wait_impl also calls _safe_tolist_2d(input_tensor): another D2H / stream sync, before payload launch. batch: stage recat permutation on CUDA Payload awaitable construction prepares the GPU permutation from host metadata. batch: launch lengths and ID values AllToAll Construct tensors awaitables from host receive sizes; two separate payload collectives for the baseline KJT. The two variants below are alternatives for consuming this state, not consecutive stages. Ordinary sparse pipeline PipelinedForward pops tensors request + module context Second wait: consume payload and reconstruct KJT PipelinedForward calls request.wait(); the metadata read inside dist_init is expanded below. batch: dist_init -> sync -> length_per_key Fixed-stride reconstructed KJT, uncached nonempty CUDA lengths: D2H + current-stream sync before input is returned. Training stream joins data_dist; record_stream compute_and_output_dist(context, distributed input) Prefetch pipeline _prefetch: second wait and KJT reconstruction prefetch_embeddings consumes payload on data_dist before cache prefetch. batch: dist_init -> sync -> length_per_key Fixed-stride reconstructed KJT, uncached nonempty CUDA lengths: D2H + current-stream sync before input is returned. module.prefetch; save ready input + context Prefetch stream joins data_dist before the module prefetch call. PrefetchPipelinedForward pops ready input + saved context Train stream joins prefetch stream compute_and_output_dist(context, distributed input)

svg.text: D1 send sizes / D2 receive sizes / D3 reconstructed KJT metadata match the row-wise input-distribution diagram.
V1 and V2 are extra validation readbacks in the pinned version; V1 repeats for each staged split tensor.
Labels identify read sites, not fixed stall counts. Cached / empty paths can skip D1 or D3; stream waits alone do not imply a host read.
TorchRec 1d87b8f79b7b / Logical scopes, not measured durations. Request wait consumes a handle; stream dependencies order GPU work.
